    def paint_plan(draw):
        g = draw.g
        state = g.Save()
        g.TranslateTransform(670.0, 144.0)
        g.SetClip(RectangleF(0, 0, 896, 504))
        light = Color.FromArgb(181, 186, 192)
        ink = Color.FromArgb(78, 80, 84)
        fill = Color.FromArgb(230, 230, 230)
        draw.rect(0, 0, 896, 504, C_WHITE)
        # Wall poche, partitions, door leaves and swings are vector illustration only.
        walls = [(64, 0, 26, 119), (64, 119, 292, 26), (330, 0, 26, 119),
                 (445, 0, 38, 105), (445, 105, 104, 55), (530, 0, 18, 105),
                 (64, 145, 26, 359), (64, 282, 83, 26), (254, 282, 329, 26),
                 (690, 282, 171, 26), (841, 160, 20, 344), (446, 308, 16, 196),
                 (690, 132, 171, 28)]
        for x, y, w, h in walls:
            draw.rect(x, y, w, h, fill, ink, 1.1)
            draw.rect(x+4, y+3, max(1,w-8), max(1,h-6), None, light, 0.7)
            # Restrained concrete texture, deterministic and dependency free.
            for tx in range(int(x+7), int(x+w-4), 13):
                for ty in range(int(y+6), int(y+h-3), 11):
                    draw.line(tx, ty, tx+1, ty+1, light, 0.6)
        for x in (23, 48):
            draw.line(x, 0, x, 504, light, 0.7)
        for y in range(20, 500, 23):
            draw.line(0, y, 63, y, light, 0.7)
        for x in (142, 158, 237, 255, 296):
            draw.line(x, 0, x, 119, light, 0.9)
        draw.rect(175, 54, 42, 58, None, light)
        draw.ellipse(193, 78, 8, 8, None, light)
        draw.line(90, 160, 445, 160, light)
        draw.line(548, 160, 690, 160, ink)
        draw.line(720, 0, 720, 131, light)
        draw.line(750, 0, 750, 131, light)
        draw.line(780, 0, 780, 131, light)
        draw.rect(498, 4, 39, 64, None, ink)
        # Door swings, matching the two marked openings.
        for x in (147, 583):
            draw.line(x+7, 307, x+7, 396, ink, 1.2)
            draw.line(x+12, 307, x+12, 392, light)
            draw.arc(x-82, 218, 190, 178, 0, 90, ink, 1.1)
        draw.line(620, 132, 620, 67, ink)
        draw.arc(555, 67, 130, 130, 270, 90, ink)
        draw.line(620, 132, 690, 132, light)
        # Dining table, chairs, casework, sink and plan dimension strings.
        draw.rect(255, 431, 150, 62, None, light)
        for x in (273, 330):
            draw.rect(x, 412, 44, 17, None, light)
            draw.line(x, 417, x+44, 417, light)
            draw.rect(x, 495, 44, 17, None, light)
        draw.rect(237, 443, 16, 37, None, light)
        draw.rect(408, 443, 16, 37, None, light)
        draw.rect(757, 329, 61, 175, None, light)
        draw.rect(768, 339, 39, 58, None, light)
        draw.rect(776, 347, 23, 40, None, light)
        draw.ellipse(800, 366, 7, 7, None, light)
        draw.rect(470, 432, 58, 72, None, light)
        for x in (143, 297, 446):
            draw.line(x, 0, x, 504, Color.FromArgb(219, 222, 227), 0.7)
            for y in (100, 267, 460):
                draw.line(x-2, y-2, x+2, y+2, light, 0.8)
        # Reference-only labels. Actual annotation placement remains unchanged below.
        for x in (147, 583):
            draw.rect(x, 280, 107, 22, C_WHITE)
            g.DrawRectangle(draw.pen(C_RED, 2, True), float(x), 280.0, 107.0, 22.0)
            draw.line(x, 280, x, 310, C_RED, 1.7)
            draw.line(x+107, 280, x+107, 310, C_RED, 1.7)
            draw.line(x+18, 278, x+29, 257, C_RED, 1.8)
            draw.polygon([(x+18,278), (x+18,269), (x+24,272)], C_RED)
            label_state = g.Save()
            g.TranslateTransform(float(x+29), 257.0)
            g.RotateTransform(-16.0)
            draw.line(0, 0, 222, 0, C_RED, 1.5)
            draw.text("BULKHEAD @ 9'-0\" A.F.F.", 0, -28, 242, 30, 19, C_RED, True)
            g.Restore(label_state)
        g.Restore(state)

            draw.text('Pranay Parkar', 109, 821, 210, 25, 17, C_INK, True)
            draw.line(335, 804, 335, 840, Color.FromArgb(210, 220, 234))
            draw.icon('people', 435, 820)
            draw.text('Support', 477, 799, 400, 23, 14, C_MUTED)
            draw.text('Akshay Rawat  |  Harshada Hikare', 477, 821, 410, 25, 17, C_INK, True)
            draw.line(905, 804, 905, 840, Color.FromArgb(210, 220, 234))
            draw.icon('people', 1004, 820)
            draw.text('BIM Automation Specialists', 1042, 799, 510, 23, 14, C_MUTED)
            draw.text('Joshua Hosteler  |  Raleigh Smith  |  Suraj Kumar  |  Utkarsh Guar',
                      1042, 822, 525, 25, 15, C_INK, True)
        finally:
            for resource in reversed(resources):

    def place_field(control, index, key):
        # Insets leave the painted rounded field border visible.
        control.Font = ui_font
        control.ForeColor = C_INK
        control.BackColor = C_WHITE
        control.TabIndex = index
        control.AccessibleName = row_info[index][1]
        y = 257 + index * 56
        bounds(control, 304, y+13, 313, 28)
        if isinstance(control, ComboBox):
            control.FlatStyle = System.Windows.Forms.FlatStyle.Flat
            control.IntegralHeight = False
            control.DropDownHeight = px(260)
            control.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed
            control.ItemHeight = px(24)
            def draw_item(sender, event):
                if event.Index < 0:
                    return
                event.DrawBackground()
                selected = (event.State & DrawItemState.Selected) == DrawItemState.Selected
                brush = SolidBrush(C_WHITE if selected else C_INK)
                try:
                    event.Graphics.DrawString(str(sender.Items[event.Index]), ui_font, brush,
                                              float(event.Bounds.X+2), float(event.Bounds.Y+px(2)))
                finally:
                    brush.Dispose()
                event.DrawFocusRectangle()
            control.DrawItem += DrawItemEventHandler(draw_item)
        surface.Controls.Add(control)
        controls[key] = control
        return control

    def make_combo(items, selected_label=None, include_default=None):
        combo = ComboBox()
        combo.DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList
        combo.Font = Font("Segoe UI", 9.5, FontStyle.Regular)
        combo.BackColor = C_WHITE
        combo.ForeColor = C_INK
        labels = []
        if include_default is not None:
            labels.append(include_default)
        labels.extend(sorted([value for value in items.keys() if value != include_default],
                             key=lambda value: value.lower()))
        if not labels:
            labels = ["<None available>"]
        for label in labels:
            combo.Items.Add(label)

        preferred = None
        if selected_label:
            selected_norm = norm(selected_label)
            for label in labels:
                if norm(label) == selected_norm:
                    preferred = label
                    break
            if preferred is None:
                compact_target = re.sub(r"[\s_\-]+", "", selected_norm)
                for label in labels:
                    compact_label = re.sub(r"[\s_\-]+", "", norm(label))
                    if compact_label == compact_target:
                        preferred = label
                        break
            if preferred is None:
                for label in labels:
                    if not label.startswith("<") and selected_norm in norm(label):
                        preferred = label
                        break
        if preferred is None:
            preferred = labels[0]
        try:
            combo.SelectedIndex = labels.index(preferred)
        except Exception:
            combo.SelectedIndex = 0
        return combo

        rot_deg = 0.0

    settings = {
        "run_room_finishes": False,
        "run_opening_markup": True,
        "create_missing_rooms": False,
        "skip_existing_tagged_rooms": False,
        "finish_text_type_name": "",
        "finish_text_type": None,
        "room_tag_type_name": "",
        "room_tag_type": None,
        "finish_gap_mm": 25.0,
        "opening_filter": str(family_combo.Text or "").strip(),
        "opening_text": str(opening_text_box.Text or ""),
        "opening_text_type_name": opening_text_label if not opening_text_label.startswith("<") else "",
        "opening_text_type": selected_object(open_text_combo, text_type_map),
        "opening_line_style_name": line_label if not line_label.startswith("<") else "",
        "opening_line_style": selected_object(line_combo, line_style_map),
        "opening_rotation_deg": rot_deg,
        "opening_offset_mm": 0.0,
        "new_room_name": "",
        "orientation": orientation,
        "replace_existing_tags": True
    }
    form.Dispose()
    ui_font.Dispose()
    logo_image.Dispose()
    logo_stream.Dispose()
    return settings

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EXECUTION ROUTINE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ui_cancelled = False
try:
    smart_settings = show_smart_ui()
    if smart_settings is None:
        ui_cancelled = True
    else:
        run_room_finishes = smart_settings["run_room_finishes"]
        run_opening_markup = smart_settings["run_opening_markup"]
        create_missing_rooms = smart_settings["create_missing_rooms"]
        skip_existing_tagged_rooms = smart_settings["skip_existing_tagged_rooms"]
        finish_text_type_name = smart_settings["finish_text_type_name"]
        opening_filter = smart_settings["opening_filter"]
        opening_text = smart_settings["opening_text"]
        opening_text_template = opening_text or 'BULKHEAD @ {height} A.F.F.'
        opening_text_type_name = smart_settings["opening_text_type_name"]
        opening_line_style_name = smart_settings["opening_line_style_name"]
        finish_gap_mm = smart_settings["finish_gap_mm"]
        opening_offset_mm = smart_settings["opening_offset_mm"]
        opening_rotation_deg = smart_settings["opening_rotation_deg"]
        replace_existing_tags = True  # Always replace this tool's tracked annotations on rerun.
        room_tag_type_name = smart_settings["room_tag_type_name"]
        new_room_name = smart_settings["new_room_name"]
        finish_text_type = smart_settings["finish_text_type"]
        opening_text_type = smart_settings["opening_text_type"]
        selected_room_tag_type = smart_settings["room_tag_type"]
        overhead_line_style = smart_settings["opening_line_style"]
        report["UI"] = "Smart UI — Bulkhead Only"
        report["AvailableTextNoteTypes"] = [get_element_name(x) for x in get_all_text_note_types()]
        report["SelectedFinishTextType"] = finish_text_type_name
        report["SelectedOpeningTextType"] = opening_text_type_name
except Exception as ui_ex:
    add_warning("UI error: {}".format(ui_ex))
    report["Status"] = "UI ERROR — no model changes made"
    report["FatalError"] = str(ui_ex)
    ui_cancelled = True

if ui_cancelled:
    report["Status"] = "Cancelled by user"
    OUT = report
else:
    try:
        if view is None or view.ViewType not in (ViewType.FloorPlan, ViewType.CeilingPlan, ViewType.EngineeringPlan):
            raise Exception("Open a Floor Plan, Reflected Ceiling Plan, or Engineering Plan view.")
        view_level = view.GenLevel
        view_elevation = view_level.Elevation
        report["Level"] = get_element_name(view_level)

        if run_room_finishes:
            sheets = read_xlsx_sheets(excel_path)
            ceiling_map = build_type_map(sheets.get("Ceiling Types", []), "Ceiling Types")
            flooring_map = build_type_map(sheets.get("Flooring Types", []), "Flooring Types")
        else:
            ceiling_map = {}
            flooring_map = {}

        if finish_text_type is None and finish_text_type_name:
            finish_text_type = find_type_by_name(BuiltInCategory.OST_TextNotes, finish_text_type_name)
        if opening_text_type is None and opening_text_type_name:
            opening_text_type = find_type_by_name(BuiltInCategory.OST_TextNotes, opening_text_type_name)
        if selected_room_tag_type is None and room_tag_type_name:
            selected_room_tag_type = find_room_tag_type_flexible(room_tag_type_name)
        if overhead_line_style is None and opening_line_style_name:
            overhead_line_style = get_line_style(opening_line_style_name)

    except Exception as startup_err:
        report["Status"] = "ERROR"
        report["FatalError"] = str(startup_err)
        OUT = report
    else:
        tx_started = False
        try:
            TransactionManager.Instance.EnsureInTransaction(doc)
            tx_started = True

            if create_missing_rooms and run_room_finishes:
                create_missing_room_elements(view_level, view, new_room_name)

            doc.Regenerate()

            rooms = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Rooms).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
            if not rooms:
                all_rooms = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Rooms).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
                rooms = [r for r in all_rooms if r.Area > 1e-6 and (r.LevelId == view_level.Id or (r.Level and r.Level.Id == view_level.Id))]
            
            ceiling_elements = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Ceilings).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
            floor_elements = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
            report["RoomsScanned"] = len(rooms)

            room_tags_by_room = get_room_tags_in_view()
            existing_text_notes = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(TextNote).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
            existing_curve_elements = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(CurveElement).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

            room_plans = []
            for room in rooms:
                existing_tags = room_tags_by_room.get(room.Id, [])
                if existing_tags and skip_existing_tagged_rooms:
                    report["RoomsSkippedAlreadyTagged"] += 1
                    continue

                base_elevation = get_room_base_elevation(room)
                upper_elevation = get_room_upper_elevation(room, base_elevation)
                most_spacious_pt = compute_room_most_empty_space(room, base_elevation, view_elevation)
                if most_spacious_pt is None: continue

                samples = room_sample_points(room, base_elevation, 7) or [(most_spacious_pt.X, most_spacious_pt.Y)]
                ceiling_candidates = collect_spatial_type_groups(ceiling_elements, room, samples, base_elevation, upper_elevation, "ceiling")
                floor_candidates = collect_spatial_type_groups(floor_elements, room, samples, base_elevation, upper_elevation, "floor")

                selected_ceiling = ceiling_candidates[0] if ceiling_candidates else None
                selected_floor = floor_candidates[0] if floor_candidates else None

                room_name = get_room_display_name(room)
                ceiling_type_name = selected_ceiling["type"] if selected_ceiling else ""
                ceiling_code = find_shortcut(ceiling_type_name, ceiling_map) if selected_ceiling else ""
                floor_type_name = selected_floor["type"] if selected_floor else ""
                floor_code = find_shortcut(floor_type_name, flooring_map) if selected_floor else ""
                
                # Check if cooler/freezer -> skip ceiling & height, add flooring shortcut only
                special_cold_room = is_cooler_or_freezer(room_name, ceiling_type_name, floor_type_name)
                ceiling_height_text = ""

                if not special_cold_room and selected_ceiling and ceiling_code and norm(ceiling_code) != "open":
                    floor_ref_z = selected_floor["z"] if selected_floor else base_elevation
                    height_ft = selected_ceiling["z"] - floor_ref_z
                    if height_ft > 0.0: ceiling_height_text = format_feet_inches(height_ft)

                detail_lines = []
                if special_cold_room:
                    if floor_code: detail_lines.append(floor_code)
                else:
                    if selected_ceiling:
                        if ceiling_code: detail_lines.append(ceiling_code)
                        if ceiling_code and norm(ceiling_code) != "open" and ceiling_height_text:
                            detail_lines.append(ceiling_height_text)
                    else:
                        detail_lines.append("OPEN")
                    if floor_code: detail_lines.append(floor_code)

                room_plans.append({
                    "room": room, "center": most_spacious_pt, "finish_text": "\n".join(detail_lines)
                })

            room_tag_targets = {}
            if run_room_finishes:
                for plan in room_plans:
                    room = plan["room"]
                    tags = room_tags_by_room.get(room.Id, [])
                    tag = tags[0] if tags else None
                    if tag is None:
                        uv_pt = UV(plan["center"].X, plan["center"].Y)
                        new_tag = None
                        tag_error = None
                        try:
                            new_tag = doc.Create.NewRoomTag(LinkElementId(room.Id), uv_pt, view.Id)
                        except Exception as tag_ex:
                            tag_error = str(tag_ex)
                            # Retry at the Room location point if the computed interior point is rejected.
                            try:
                                location = room.Location
                                if isinstance(location, LocationPoint):
                                    uv_fallback = UV(location.Point.X, location.Point.Y)
                                    new_tag = doc.Create.NewRoomTag(LinkElementId(room.Id), uv_fallback, view.Id)
                                    tag_error = None
                            except Exception as fallback_ex:
                                tag_error = "{} | fallback: {}".format(tag_error, fallback_ex)
                        if new_tag:
                            if selected_room_tag_type:
                                try:
                                    new_tag.ChangeTypeId(selected_room_tag_type.Id)
                                except Exception as type_ex:
                                    add_warning("Room {} tag was created but type '{}' could not be applied: {}".format(
                                        get_element_name(room), room_tag_type_name, type_ex))
                            tag = new_tag
                            room_tags_by_room.setdefault(room.Id, []).append(new_tag)
                            report["RoomTagsCreated"] += 1
                        else:
                            add_warning("Room Tag creation failed for Room '{}': {}".format(
                                get_element_name(room), tag_error or "Revit did not return a RoomTag"))

                    if tag: room_tag_targets[room.Id] = tag

                doc.Regenerate()

                if finish_text_type is None:
                    add_warning("Room finish notes skipped: select a valid Finish Text Type.")
                if finish_text_type:
                    gap_ft = mm_to_ft(max(0.0, finish_gap_mm))
                    for plan in room_plans:
                        if not plan["finish_text"]: continue
                        tag = room_tag_targets.get(plan["room"].Id)
                        if tag is None:
                            tags = room_tags_by_room.get(plan["room"].Id, [])
                            tag = tags[0] if tags else None
                        
                        tag_bbox = get_tag_bbox(tag) if tag else None
                        target = XYZ(tag_bbox.Min.X, tag_bbox.Min.Y - gap_ft, view_elevation) if tag_bbox else XYZ(plan["center"].X, plan["center"].Y - gap_ft, view_elevation)
                        try:
                            _, res = upsert_textnote(existing_text_notes, target, plan["finish_text"], finish_text_type, 0.0)
                            if res == "created": report["FinishNotesCreated"] += 1
                            elif res == "updated": report["FinishNotesUpdated"] += 1
                        except Exception: pass

            if run_opening_markup and opening_filter:
                # Prefer explicitly selected Generic Models. If none are selected,
                # scan all Generic Model instances in the document, not just the view.
                selected_gms = bh_get_selected_generic_models(uiapp.ActiveUIDocument, doc)
                report["SelectedGenericModels"] = len(selected_gms)
                if selected_gms:
                    opening_instances = []
                    for candidate in selected_gms:
                        if bh_matches(candidate, opening_filter, doc):
                            opening_instances.append(candidate)
                    if not opening_instances:
                        # Explicit selection is a deliberate user target; trust it if
                        # family/type names are not exposed by the API.
                        opening_instances = selected_gms[:]
                        add_warning("Selected Generic Models did not expose a matching family/type name; using the explicit selection.")
                    report["OpeningScanScope"] = "selected Generic Models"
                else:
                    opening_instances = list(
                        FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                        .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_GenericModel)
                        .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                        .ToElements()
                    )
                    opening_instances = [candidate for candidate in opening_instances
                                         if bh_matches(candidate, opening_filter, doc)]
                    report["OpeningScanScope"] = "document-wide Generic Models matching filter"

                report["OpeningInstancesScanned"] = len(selected_gms) if selected_gms else len(
                    FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_GenericModel)
                    .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
                report["OpeningInstancesMatched"] = len(opening_instances)
                report["OpeningFilter"] = opening_filter
                # Replace this tool's prior annotations for the matched opening instances.
                # The tracking data is attached to generated elements, so unrelated user
                # detail lines/text notes are not deleted.
                if replace_existing_tags:
                    report["PreviousAnnotationsDeleted"] = bh_delete_previous_annotations(
                        [x.Id.IntegerValue for x in opening_instances])
                else:
                    report["PreviousAnnotationsDeleted"] = 0
                report["OpeningGeometry"] = []
                report["OpeningHeightsDetected"] = []

                if not opening_instances:
                    examples = []
                    try:
                        all_gms = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                            .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_GenericModel)
                            .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
                        for candidate in all_gms:
                            fam, typ = bh_get_family_type(candidate, doc)
                            label = "{} : {}".format(fam, typ)
                            if label.strip(" :") and label not in examples:
                                examples.append(label)
                            if len(examples) >= 30:
                                break
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    add_warning("No opening instances matched '{}'. Generic Model family/type examples: {}".format(
                        opening_filter, " | ".join(examples) if examples else "<none found>"))

                # Refresh annotation collectors after any room tags/notes were created.
                existing_curve_elements = list(
                    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(CurveElement)
                    .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())
                existing_text_notes = list(
                    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(TextNote)
                    .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements())

                if overhead_line_style is None and opening_line_style_name:
                    overhead_line_style = get_line_style(opening_line_style_name)
                report["RequestedOpeningLineStyle"] = opening_line_style_name
                report["ResolvedOpeningLineStyle"] = (
                    str(overhead_line_style.Name) if overhead_line_style is not None else None)
                if overhead_line_style is None:
                    add_warning("Bulkhead line style '{}' was not resolved; no bulkhead outline lines can be created.".format(
                        opening_line_style_name))

                if opening_text_type is None and opening_text_type_name:
                    opening_text_type = find_type_by_name(BuiltInCategory.OST_TextNotes, opening_text_type_name)
                if opening_text_type is None:
                    add_warning("Bulkhead Text Note Type '{}' was not resolved; no bulkhead labels can be created.".format(
                        opening_text_type_name))

                for inst in opening_instances:
                    try:
                        bbox = bh_bbox_of(inst, view)
                        if bbox is None:
                            add_warning("Opening id {} has no bounding box; skipped.".format(inst.Id.IntegerValue))
                            continue

                        segments, geometry_source, center, angle = bh_rectangle_segments(inst, bbox, view_elevation)
                        if not geometry_source.startswith("active-view family curves"):
                            add_warning("Opening id {}: Revit did not expose visible family plan curves; used a transform/dimension fallback. Check report['OpeningGeometry'] before relying on exact overlay.".format(inst.Id.IntegerValue))
                        # Recalculate from both sides of the actual generated outline, not just
                        # the family insertion point or one edge. This centres the annotation
                        # between the opposing long and short sides of the box.
                        outline_center = bh_center_from_outline_segments(segments, angle, view_elevation)
                        if outline_center is not None:
                            center = outline_center
                        report["OpeningGeometry"].append({
                            "Id": inst.Id.IntegerValue,
                            "OutlineSegments": len(segments),
                            "OutlineSource": geometry_source,
                            "CenterXYFt": (round(center.X, 3), round(center.Y, 3)),
                            "AngleDegrees": round(math.degrees(angle), 2),
                            "HostWallAngleDegrees": (round(math.degrees(bh_host_wall_angle(inst)), 2)
                                                      if bh_host_wall_angle(inst) is not None else None)
                        })

                        # Trace every edge of the projected opening footprint.
                        if overhead_line_style is not None:
                            for seg_a, seg_b in segments:
                                if seg_a.DistanceTo(seg_b) <= 0.05:
                                    continue
                                if detail_curve_matches(existing_curve_elements, seg_a, seg_b,
                                                        opening_line_style_name, tolerance_ft=0.05):
                                    report["OpeningLinesAlreadyPresent"] += 1
                                    continue
                                try:
                                    detail = doc.Create.NewDetailCurve(view, Line.CreateBound(seg_a, seg_b))
                                    detail.LineStyle = overhead_line_style
                                    bh_tag_generated_annotation(detail, inst.Id.IntegerValue, "LINE")
                                    existing_curve_elements.append(detail)
                                    report["OpeningLinesCreated"] += 1
                                except Exception as line_ex:
                                    add_warning("Bulkhead outline segment failed for opening id {}: {}".format(
                                        inst.Id.IntegerValue, line_ex))

                        # Height is resolved from instance/type parameters, then model geometry.
                        height_ft, height_source = bh_get_opening_height_ft(inst, bbox, view_elevation)
                        height_text = bh_format_feet_inches(height_ft) if height_ft > 0.1 else "HEIGHT NOT FOUND"
                        report["OpeningHeightsDetected"].append({
                            "Id": inst.Id.IntegerValue,
                            "Height": height_text,
                            "Source": height_source
                        })
                        if height_ft <= 0.1:
                            report["OpeningHeightsNotFoundCount"] = report.get("OpeningHeightsNotFoundCount", 0) + 1
                            add_warning("Opening id {}: height could not be detected; label will say HEIGHT NOT FOUND.".format(
                                inst.Id.IntegerValue))
                        else:
                            report["OpeningHeightsFoundCount"] = report.get("OpeningHeightsFoundCount", 0) + 1

                        # Keep the label INSIDE the opening outline, at its traced center.
                        # Use the angle returned by the same footprint geometry that created
                        # the outline. Do not substitute Host wall direction or a manual angle:
                        # either can differ from the actual projected opening in plan.
                        template = opening_text_template or 'BULKHEAD @ {height} A.F.F.'
                        resolved_text = template.replace("{height}", height_text)
                        rot = bh_normalize_text_angle(angle)
                        if opening_rotation_deg >= 0.0:
                            rot = bh_normalize_text_angle(math.radians(opening_rotation_deg))
                        text_pt = XYZ(center.X, center.Y, view_elevation)

                        if opening_text_type is not None:
                            try:
                                note, result = upsert_textnote(existing_text_notes, text_pt, resolved_text,
                                                               opening_text_type, rot)
                                if note is not None:
                                    bh_tag_generated_annotation(note, inst.Id.IntegerValue, "TEXT")
                                    # Centre the visible text extents on the centre calculated
                                    # between both sides of the outline, after applying rotation.
                                    bh_center_note_visual_bbox(note, text_pt, view)
                                if result == "created":
                                    report["OpeningNotesCreated"] += 1
                                elif result == "updated":
                                    report["OpeningNotesUpdated"] += 1
                            except Exception as note_ex:
                                add_warning("Bulkhead text failed for opening id {}: {}".format(
                                    inst.Id.IntegerValue, note_ex))
                    except Exception as opening_ex:
                        add_warning("Bulkhead processing failed for opening id {}: {}".format(
                            inst.Id.IntegerValue, opening_ex))
        except Exception as exec_err:
            add_warning("Execution error: {}".format(exec_err))
        finally:
            if tx_started:
                try: TransactionManager.Instance.TransactionTaskDone()
                except Exception: pass

        report["Status"] = "Completed with warnings" if report["Warnings"] else "Completed"
        OUT = report
